title: OpenAPI Spec Compiler
description: Aggregator compiler: collects route-artifact.json files, assembles and validates a complete OpenAPI 3.1 document. Input = compiled routes. Output = openapi-artifact.json.

pipeline.title: Collect
pipeline.description: Locate all route-artifact.json files in scope. Read openapi-spec.json for title, version, servers, auth schemes.

pipeline.title: Validate Fragments
pipeline.description: Validate each route's openapi.json fragment: method, path, requestBody, responses, operationId

pipeline.title: Assemble
pipeline.description: Merge all fragments into a single OpenAPI 3.1 document with info, servers, paths, components

pipeline.title: Verify
pipeline.description: Cross-check auth schemes, verify all security references are defined, check contract compliance

pipeline.title: Attest
pipeline.description: Produce signed openapi-artifact.json for the registry

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: openapi-spec.json exists with required fields: title, version, servers[]

gates.title: Routes Found
gates.description: At least one route-artifact.json found in the declared scan paths

gates.title: Fragments Valid
gates.description: Every route's openapi.json fragment has: method, path, operationId, at least one 2xx response

gates.title: No Conflicts
gates.description: No duplicate operationIds across routes. No two routes with identical method+path.

gates.title: OpenAPI Valid
gates.description: Assembled openapi.json is valid OpenAPI 3.1: has info, paths, components. All $ref targets exist.

gates.title: All Routes Covered
gates.description: Every route-artifact.json in scope has a corresponding path entry in the assembled spec

gates.title: Schemas Referenced
gates.description: All $ref values in paths point to schemas defined in components/schemas — no dangling refs

gates.title: Auth Schemes
gates.description: All security schemes used in route fragments are defined in components/securitySchemes

gates.title: OpenAPI Contract
gates.description: Document satisfies structural contract: versioned, has contact info, all errors documented, no empty paths

contracts.description: Structural requirements for compiled OpenAPI documents

error_codes.OS002: No route-artifact.json files found in scan paths
error_codes.OS003: Route openapi.json fragment invalid or missing required fields
error_codes.OS004: Duplicate operationId or method+path conflict across routes
error_codes.OS006: route-artifact not covered in assembled spec
error_codes.OS007: Dangling $ref — schema referenced but not defined in components/schemas
error_codes.OS008: Security scheme used in route but not defined in components/securitySchemes
error_codes.OS009: OpenAPI contract violation (missing contact, undocumented errors, empty paths)
